name: @stemmory/schema
description: Frontmatter schema v1 validator for Stemmory feature docs. Mirrored from the Stemmory product repo — see scripts/check-schema-parity.mjs.
//publishConfig: Required, not leftover: npm defaults SCOPED packages to access=restricted, so @stemmory/schema needs access:public to publish publicly at all. Do not remove it.
//exports: src/ stays untouched TypeScript (parity manifest hashes it directly). dist/ is the bundled+typed build a plain-node consumer actually imports - see scripts/check-schema-parity.mjs and the build script below.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --external zod --out-dir dist --clean --target node20
